description: This Zenodo workbook assembles national inputs for long-term climate, land, energy and water systems modelling in Lao PDR. Repository metadata describe energy-generation technologies, future resources, demand, electricity exports, emissions, transmission and distribution assumptions for 2020–2070. Land sheets include crop demand and imports and projected cover change; water sheets include sector water requirements and hydrological activity ratios for land-cover types. The article cites record 14282913, while the same concept has a later public record 15491930 with a changed workbook size; this draft uses the later record and preserves the original link. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 and lists one XLSX file. These are compiled and projected model inputs, not observations of every future system state. Source-year differences and assumptions within the workbook are limitations for scenario reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing CLEW scenarios or checking cross-sector resource constraints. model-osemosys is a related energy-system model; direct compatibility was not tested. No workbook was downloaded.
